column1: # Game profile of Blasphemous 2 (Switch, update 1.0.8 = v524288). Plays on Android (android.tsv)
# Unity 2021.3.20f1 IL2CPP with FMOD, SDK 15.3.2, NVN; subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie, which plays the H.264 cinematics. Written from the survey, with the memory values
# upstream's Mac bring-up measured (seedds/nxnative's profile of this game, read as a reference). The DLC NSP (Mea Culpa, 010040801A4C9001) is a licence only: its content is in the update
# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so the game has virtual address memory. The 5 GB block of the other Unity games with it (256 MB in front + 4.375 GB alias region
# + 256 MB stack region). Upstream measured on the Mac that StandardAllocator with the hardware's pool and Unity's own regions reach +4.26 GB of the alias region during startup;
# a 1 GB pool leaves room for Unity's regions. The sdk build gets the node-area cut and the size-class alignment cuts (dm/tools/sdk_patches.py)
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; Unity Shader objects read by unityfs.py, and the player's eleven GLSLC outputs in main) ----
# everything is under Data/: the player's serialized files and the StreamingAssets bundles
